notes.title: FIX PATCH v0.4.1
notes.content:
Hello Chefs 👨‍🍳👩‍🍳,

We're back with another update! Over the past week, we've carefully listened to your feedback and decided to release this mid-cycle patch completely focusing on fixes and adjustments between the huge updates we're still working on.

Rest assured, we hear you loud and clear and we’re always keeping a close eye on your feedbacks on Kebab Chefs!

[h3]🔧 Co-op Room Disconnection Issue[/h3]

We’ve resolved a bug that caused players to be kicked from co-op sessions especially while managing the second restaurant. You can now cook with friends without interruptions!

[h3]🚶 Customer Stuck in Front of Second Restaurant[/h3]

Fixed an issue where customers would get stuck outside the second restaurant in some cases. 

[h3]🚶 Customers Getting Stuck Near Service Counters[/h3]

Fixed an issue where in some rare cases, customers would stand still even when there is food on the service counters. 

[h3]🎮 Players Moving Forward on Its Own[/h3]

Some players reported that their character would move forward automatically without any input. Interestingly, we noticed that disabling Steam Input via the Steam interface helped resolve the issue for several users.

While we haven’t yet been able to reproduce this bug consistently, we believe we’ve addressed the root cause behind it in this update. Please give it another try and let us know if the issue persists. We greatly appreciate your continued feedback.

If the problem is still occurring, you can try the workaround by following these steps below:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38829978/cfb6501ce36619e680b10d40fcc8c1c46a8818b3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38829978/4abb43a2eef9000fc68e4d11bdad9aca2666be86.png[/img]

[h3]🍽️ Recipe Adjustments[/h3]

Fixed an issue where serving Pumpkin Soup would mistakely indicate about a missing "lamb head" ingredient.

In addition, we’ve made improvements to the descriptions of several recipes including Pumpkin Soup, Egg Salad, and Veggie Pizza to make them more clearer and more informative for all our aspiring chefs. 

[h3]🔎 Objects Disappearing from Drawers[/h3]

Fixed a bug where items placed in certain drawers would disappear after reloading your save file.

[h3] Other Fixes[/h3]

- Fixed waiters rushing out of the restaurant to clean up broken plates and glasses.
- Fixed an issue where ingredients on cookpot get flickering while transferring into a bowl, Pumpkin or Zurek bread.
- Fixed counter with sliding doors doesn't work.

You can unlock new recipes by leveling up each category on it's own!

As you know, Kebab Chefs is still in early access and can still may get save resetting features until the full release. But it's not the case now.

notes.content:
Greetings Chefs! 👨‍🍳👩‍🍳

[h3]We are thrilled to announce our brand [b]new Co-Op game mode, Master's Chef Arena![/b][/h3]

[previewyoutube=b11j0JGBVqk;full][/previewyoutube]

Tired of getting yelled by your friends? They don't like your cooking skills? Maybe it's time to show them who is the best cook! There is no more COOPERATION. It's time for COMPETITION! 🍳🔥 🎉

[h2]🥇 MASTER'S CHEF ARENA![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38829978/f25202fd0684e3555fec539cff6d65b8c12d54d3.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38829978/aef51eee38535e8aafa6a6861c9a0aa8633e6948.png[/img]

Welcome to [b]Chef Arena[/b] – the competitive cooking mode inspired by the thrill of top culinary competitions! Get ready to test your culinary skills, creativity, and speed in the kitchen. 

In Chef Arena, up to four players go head-to-head in a cooking battle. Each round, you'll have to prove yourself and create a masterpiece dish to impress the Master! 🏆👩‍⚖️

Do you have what it takes? Will you be able to become the Master's choosen? This is your chance to shine in the kitchen! 🥇 

Chef Arena Mode is available now! Show us what you’ve got! 💪

[h2]HOW TO PLAY?[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38829978/f25202fd0684e3555fec539cff6d65b8c12d54d3.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38829978/49acb1bdb1ef3d1a7cec1e22fec832e01c070ed5.png[/img]

To play the Chef's arena, go to "New Game" and select "Chef's Arena" to create a new competitive session. You can adjust mode settings as you like.

Each round, players have given a random recipe that they must complete and serve. There are two stages in the competition; Shopping and Cooking. When round starts, players need to gather necessary ingredients from the pantry nearside the kitchen. 

Once the shopping time is over, players are responsible with cooking the recipe that they are given. Before the time runs out, each players must place their dishes on the serving platform.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38829978/9434463bf69407595eb0448b588ef502f73b03f8.png[/img]
[b]Kebab Chefs! is currently %40 off during the Steam Cooking Festival![/b]

[h2]🔪 AUTOSLICER[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38829978/f25202fd0684e3555fec539cff6d65b8c12d54d3.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38829978/2a620d40f5132e89586210e90a131ede8d3292c9.gif[/img]

Just place your ingredients in the AutoSlicer, and there you have it! Speed up your prep and focus on preparing the ultimate dish!

[h2]🥟HAPPY POLAND NATIONAL INDEPENDENCE DAY![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38829978/f25202fd0684e3555fec539cff6d65b8c12d54d3.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38829978/db02fad7c7dc6295fa0fd1431e3d0b183368179d.gif[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/39130/Kebab_Station_Bundle/

Before diving into the update, I would like to start by an apology to all players who have been waiting for this update for a long time. We are well aware that we fell behind our schedule. We owe you a lot for your expectations, feedbacks and support. As you may know we are a small team that trying to expand and extend it's operations. This process costing us some time for finding all the amazing people currently with us.

I can assure you that our team is fully motivated to help reach Kebab Chefs it's full potential and bring much higher quality than ever before! We are working on other content and game mode updates which we will be sharing with you later on.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38829978/f25202fd0684e3555fec539cff6d65b8c12d54d3.png[/img]

Meet with Leonardo the Inventor! A true mastermind who has a passion for Italian food. But he has a problem! 

Leonardo is after the perfect recipe that originally created by his father. But it is missing at the moment. He believes Master has hid the codes of the recipe and Leonardo has adapted his whole life for seeking them. Will you be able to help him? 

You will granted by delicious Pizza recipes if you manage to get his approval!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38829978/d78ddcdce5acee914d8e3c75f6665ff9b98d93d0.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38829978/0cd507a02747cbb1e02b61d3908a2af050014ac8.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38829978/84d3e12ca8c57ecd59b5181e0310b97bbde71683.png[/img]

Also, you can serve your pizza's on a special plate for pizzas, instead of using the standard ones.

When you have the perfect pizza base, you can use ingredients below to shape your pizza!

[u]Ingredients you can use for pizzas:[/u]
[list]
[*] Basil
[*] Olive
[*] Corn
[*] Tomato
[*] Mozzarella
[*] Tomato paste (for sauce)
[*] Garlic (for sauce)
[*] Onion
[*] Green pepper
[*] Olives
[*] Mushroom
[*] Pineapple
[*] Pepperoni
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38829978/55d51cac97ce498f83f4eaadcb4e4522a6f1c9f3.png[/img]

[url=https://discord.gg/kebabchefs][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38829978/8f82d2414adca809e37718d248d2e6cd0e5be775.png[/img][/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38829978/f25202fd0684e3555fec539cff6d65b8c12d54d3.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38829978/5486f509303c0cf5bf5697bb56e39be34869c0f7.gif[/img]

You should still crack the egg after boiling it If you crack a raw egg, you will be getting an egg yolk instead! You will need a frying pan to cook raw eggs. Also, you can now grill your meatballs in frying pans as well!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38829978/d313e84ecda0fcc79cb18b7126714106fd0e5fc2.gif[/img]

These changes on eggs also will be a base for the recipes that we will add in the future. You can now use eggs for two more recipes.

[h1]💬 STORY REWORK[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38829978/f25202fd0684e3555fec539cff6d65b8c12d54d3.png[/img]

notes.title: NEW MAP & NEW MODE! | OUTDOOR CUSTOMIZATIONS 🍳🎉 PATCH v0.2.3
notes.content:
[b]Greetings Chefs![/b]👨‍🍳👩🏻‍🍳

We're back with another update! With this update, we are having a new map, a game mode and more customization options!

[h3]Just before getting into the details, we wanted to share that Kebab Chefs! is now 💵 [b]%40 off[/b] as a part of the Steam Summer Sale with our biggest discount yet! 

Let your friends know about your culinary adventure![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38829978/c0dd9c4424b784a948d108157658796223214663.png[/img]

Let's dive into the update then!

[h1][b]💪🏻 New Difficulty: Hard [/b][/h1]

We are introducing a new difficulty setting "Hard Mode" where players are responsible for serving unique dishes to every single customer! We recommend this option for experienced players.  

Normally, you serve your delicious dishes on service counters and serving system relies on a self-service logic in Kebab Chefs. But many of the feedbacks suggested that there should be another setting where players can serve to customers individually. 

You can select hard difficulty while you are starting a new game on main menu. There are also more elements making the mode harder. You can also check them out while starting a new game as can be seen below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38829978/42b123da8c709d8bb7b9da608513e4a22718786e.png[/img]

[h1][b]🗺️ New Location: The Studio & Free Mode![/b][/h1]

Here's our new location! The Studio! 

Now we have a new place to cook! But what can you cook there? Anything you want! You can try out and challenge yourself for any recipes without having to unlock them. You have everything you may need! Stations, tools, ingredients... Time to test your skills!

But wait, this place looks more like a live show environment isn't it? That's right, this map is actually also part of something different. But let's keep it for future updates!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38829978/e58a6616ccbc7973e1d9984a650600f2b46e0f63.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38829978/c1d75a60a5dc0a6439de303db52a62926fcbd690.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38829978/9a7a75f86c3727fa1b2372b5dc7897165ab60ef0.png[/img]

[h1][b]🎨 Outdoor Customizations[/b][/h1]

We are continuing to increase the customizability in Kebab Chefs! You can now change the design of outer walls, place awnings and decoration objects in front of your restaurant!

After providing new options for garden side, we realized that players haven't got any control over the outside look of their restaurants. So we decided to extend the area in front of the buildings and make it a placeable region. We are planning to add even more options in the future updates!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38829978/07ca5d2fe05284839a5abb833af6e8974d4bfc0d.gif[/img]

[h3]Also you can now buy and place an aquarium to your restaurant! Looks cool isn't it?[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38829978/6d9a17efbca282eeb95e506d14e7c19c9b962493.gif[/img]

That's it for todays update. There are a lot more on the way! We will be sharing a new and short term roadmap very soon! Don't forget to join our [url=https://discord.gg/kebabchefs]Discord Community from here[/url] to make sure you don't miss it!

BG Team

[b]Greetings Chefs![/b]👨‍🍳👩🏻‍🍳

It's been a while since our last update. We apologize for the wait but we will have good news as well. Biotech Gameworks team is in a middle of a forming stage to bring high quality and faster updates. It's almost 4 months since game is on early access. It was an intense a couple of months for us but hey, we are finally here with another big update as usual!

As you may noticed, we were constantly bringing new contents to the game in our recent updates. New recipes, new stations, events and so on. But in this update, we are slowing down for a bit on new content and patching things up and polishing what we have done so far for the main game mode of Kebab Chefs! 

"What does main mode means? Will there be more?" you may ask. Yes, there will be more game modes added to the game soon!

This update focuses more on improving existing features, bug fixes, optimizations. Of course, it also includes plenty of appealing new stuff as well.

[h3]Also [b]Kebab Chefs! is now %30 off 💰 on Weekend Deal! [/b]Don't miss out the oppoturnity if you're looking to cook anytime soon![/h3]

Enough opening talk. Let's take a closer look at our new update now!

[h1][b]👨‍👩‍👦 Group Customers[/b][/h1]

Lots of feedbacks we receive was complaining about four people tables are being useless in their current state and there should be grouped people come in and fill other chairs as well.

You can now have groups of customers visit your restaurant. With this new feature, customer flow will get more interesting and 4-seater tables will be more effective!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38829978/5ce391c72b9b4212ec794931a25274cc4c032845.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]🧽 Dishwashing 2.0![/b][/h1]

Dishwashing system changes! We think that handling dishes in the game was the most incomplete part of the game and it was so hard to manage dishes with their current mechanics since you were not able to collect multiple dirty dishes at once and you had to place clean ones back one by one.

With the new update, dishwashing becomes much more systematic and entertaining! We have removed traditional sinks from your kitchen and introduced a single station called the "industrial sink" 

The new station includes two trays for your dirty and clean plates. You can now easily transfer your plates around and clean them by just attaching the tray with dirty plates to the new sink!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38829978/fc6ae4ba3eacecf441129ea33d09b921fda29eeb.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38829978/cda307121e94190d850531e19e7fb7932ae721fb.gif[/img]

[h1][b]📦 Unboxing[/b][/h1]

Shopping crates are perhaps one of the most interacted objects in the game. Therefore, we've made them more efficient and visually appealing. Now you can empty your boxes much more quickly and in a simpler way!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38829978/c2534f8f658c2a3c2b22227f3f1c4b7ce0746dd5.gif[/img][h3]

[h1][b]🍟 Industrial Deepfryer[/b][/h1]

We've designed a much larger and industrial version of deep frying station, which was added in the previous updates. It offers much more space compared to small one and looks way more professional!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38829978/4eebec0dc4716f903025e87c22a2b887215b209d.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]🤵🏻 Waiter AI Improvements[/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38829978/d5c8beeb87a21945dee76f89998ef233f7de5702.jpg[/img]

We have been working on worker AI improvements for a while. Now they are much more efficient and act much more intelligently. Also they can stack dishes up to 5 plates while interacting customers and prevent the waste of time while returning the plates. This improvements significantly speeds up the workflow in your restaurant.

[h1][b]💾 Steam Cloud Save[/b][/h1]

Kebab Chefs! now enabled Steam Cloud saves! Your save files should be synced automatically when you log in to game!

[h1][b]⚙️ Optimizations[/b][/h1]

We've made some CPU/GPU time optimizations in this new update. Which includes optimizations on shops, NPC behaviours, user interface, texture sizes to make your game experience even smoother. Let us know if it works better for you!

[h1][b]New Languages | 🇹🇭 🇻🇳[/b][/h1]

We are happy to announce that Kebab Chefs! supports two new languages now! We added Thai and Vietnamese to the game with the help of our community! Thanks to everyone who contributed in the localization progress!

[h1][b]👾 Bugfixes and Changes[/b][/h1]

Here you can find full list of changes and bugfixes below:

[h3]Changes[/h3]

- Easter Event removed from the game.

notes.title: Development Update - Workers!
notes.content:
Greetings to all kebab lovers!

It's been quite some time since we last meet on a development update. That's the second time we dug into development and stay silent for a while. But yet again, we are back with even more!

While we're gone, we have made a lot of improvements, developed new features and dealt with balancing in game economy in order to provide a smooth gameplay and progression feeling for you. Of course we will be introducing all of these changes but as always, we have one big topic at a time.

Also, we will be having some great news for you this very month. The day is getting closer than ever before! Don't forget to join our discord channel from [url=https://discord.gg/phyBgJf7CA]here[/url] to hear all about the news. Now on to the topic!

[h3]Worker AI[/h3]

You are finally be able to hire AI workers for your restaurant to help you run the business! This was one of the most requested features in our discord channel. Our initial thought about it to deliver this feature after early access. But then we decided to bring it before the release because when we reach late game stages, it is essential to have employees on your side to help you run the restaurant.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38829978/2d8a3252861cb1632ef4216d236808a916471890.gif[/img]

For now, you will have option to hire waiters and cleaners.

[b]Waiters: [/b]Will help you deliver dishes, collect money and take orders from customers. 

[b]Janitors: [/b]Will clean the restaurant, and provide you with a hygienic environment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38829978/bb8c9a8471245e286e9b02823fd7476ac8c54643.gif[/img]

But how does this all work? How waiter AI knows which dish to bring to which table? This is where plate marking system comes in

[h3]Marked Plates[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38829978/b1e73e7ab999859fa1532a54576bbfccd1290023.gif[/img]

As you can see above, there is a plate marked as ready to serve! Players are able to mark dishes they prepared with current active orders. When a plate is marked, an icon appears on top of the plate and any available waiter will take it to the corresponding table. 

However, this feature is also intended to use on Co-Op! This means you will also be marking plates for your friends. Whenever a players takes a marked plate, the table which plate belongs to will be highlighted to player who carries the plate. This way, you will be running your businness more smoothly and communication between players will be much more easy!

So let's call it a new beginning, small part of a long chain. I assure you that there will be much more updates and announcements in a short time and one of them is about a [b]prologue [/b]edition of the game!

See you very soon and thanks for reading all the way down here!

notes.title: Development Update - Huge UI Update!
notes.content:
Greetings, Kebab Lovers!

We are finally here with another dev update. This one is going to be about UI/UX rework we have done after the steam next fest.

Before jumping into the topic, I wanted to share that we are planning to organize a Q&A event live on our Discord channel!

During the Q&A event, we will be answering to all of your questions about the game and the game’s future. We will be announcing the date soon. So don’t forget to join our discord server if you are interested!

As we announced in our Discord server, Kebab Simulator’s early access release is postponed to early 2023. This is because we want to be able to offer you an immersive experience and be sure that you will be having a very smooth multipayer experience.

This is the longest dev update we have published so far. So please let us know how do you like our new UI in the comments. You are also welcomed to drop your suggestions in our discord channel. We would love to see you there. Hope to see you in much longer dev updates!

Back to the topic! UI... As mentioned before, we have been making changes on huge part of our game’s UI. Despite we think new UI looks way more better now, it's not the actual reason. It also made a huge impact on the functionality and became much more player friendly.

[h2]Main Menu[/h2]

Our first UI rework applies to ALL of the main menu UI. Yes, We re-designed them all over again...

First reason for this is to have a consistent UI color palette for all of the main menu UI (which we didn’t have before). On the other hand, making them compatible and easy to navigate through other game modes which we will be having in the future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38829978/c5a228083c88308147418027c81c242e0597f0dc.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38829978/325b758d1c607bef38699530e13b3bae1c4f6fe0.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38829978/68db662d38fb1f045e016cdb1d9efe47ab8a0ee8.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38829978/62a06e475b651579df316753c9c8b5c58f4629ff.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38829978/1f69904ea9b134575306de3fff9e4dc363428b4a.jpg[/img]

[h2]Say goodbye to book UI[/h2]

If you tried our demo, you may remember that we had what we call a "game book" which had the huge portion of in-game UI functionality in it. Well, it doesn't exist anymore... Actually, we were pretty happy with a book themed UI. But there were some critical issues with that book UI which were giving us some hard time.

The biggest challenge comes with such a UI theme is the expandability. We had our base system running just fine on that UI. But when it comes to adding new functionality, it quickly came out that it is so hard to extend that UI and apply what we had in mind on two seperate piece of blank space which are being the pages of the book. It was so time consuming to come up with a perfect UX design that we can apply to a book themed UI.

What we had come up with is to replace the book with a tablet which is often used in simulation games. This way, when we are in need of some free space for a new mechanic, we are just going to add another application to our tablet. And that's it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38829978/ecfce0c3deb5a1a363338831b97276231300ea72.png[/img]

[i]Build Mode[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38829978/d479b0cd44bbcfea2326d1ac0af26d59ea521a41.png[/img]

[i]Recipes and Menu[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38829978/1a402c97890b21ae3eff097fd689320a99c9a295.png[/img]


[h2]Item & Ingredient Info[/h2]

Todays last rework goes to item and ingredient info indicators. Before the update, we had a simple plain text displaying the name of the item which you are hovering. Now, we have a small pop-up which contains every possible info about that item in itself. Looks better huh?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38829978/b26bdd5d54f7335db1fb571feed9244fcb64d2d8.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38829978/0986f436cac4922c959ee7132214f4e3b6d9d71f.jpg[/img]

And that's it for another dev update. Me and my teammates are doing our best to create the most enjoyable experience we could. We apologize for the expectations for this year. But hopefully 2023 will be a great year for Kebab Simulator.

If you would like to contribute to our game or see what's going on, please don't forget to join us on discord. We really would like to hear your thoughts and suggestions for the game!

notes.title: Development Update - Playability Improvements
notes.content:
Greetings Kebab Chefs!

On the last update, we had introduced some visual improvements we made on the environment. Today, we will be taking a step to the technical side and focusing more on the playability improvements that we have been working on after the demo event. 

Thanks to everyone who played the demo and shared their feedbacks with us, we made some changes that makes the game more practical and easier to play. 

We also made some small changes on the item positioning system so players could work more symmetrically on their restaurant.

[h3]Grid System and Rotating Items Gradually![/h3]

Good news for perfectionists! Now you have more control on orientating and positioning your furnitures mathematically perfect.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38829978/8196b1034d8be0c1f228fd6f350d6184c4a7c5f4.gif[/img]

[h3]Gathering Items Quickly![/h3]

Demo shown us that carrying or plating items one by one every single time is a real pain. What we come up with is you can just grab a plate, pot or bowl and gather ingredients on to these quickly just by clicking them. Fast and effective, which would help improve the productivity in game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38829978/83c98e2ee5bb6d79f899051411cc4915b0958883.gif[/img]

[h3]Interacting While Holding An Item![/h3]

We also got so many feedbacks about being able to interact with the environment while holding items. After the demo, this was one of our top priority tasks and we are happy to say that now it's possible!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38829978/2a110bbcf83ef16151fc438efa0879623368113e.gif[/img]

[h3]Snapping System Improved![/h3]

We saw that a lot of people who played the demo couldn't really get snapping to work while placing items. So we had improved the snapping system and made it much more easier to use!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38829978/84a4e838cfef46e09a2130b7b717d268e55fb207.gif[/img]

And that's it for today, we would have some exiciting news for you on the next diary. Hope to see you very soon again!
